summary.text: Pam Brown is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 14 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 Republican primary.
An economist, she first took office in December 2024.

paragraphs.text: Pam Brown earned a high school diploma from South Kingstown High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Rhode Island in 1981 and a Ph.D. from George Mason University in 1987, and her career experience includes work as an economist.
She assumed office in the New Hampshire House on December 4, 2024.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Brown described herself as an economist and "Trump Conservative" and listed three campaign messages: limiting taxes and spending, stopping illegal immigration and sanctuary cities, and school choice for all New Hampshire families.

She named low taxes and controlled spending, business-friendly regulations, protecting Second Amendment rights, education choice and election integrity as the policy areas she is most passionate about.
